title: POTUS greets 106th Rescue Wing family and friends
description: The President of the United States, Donald J. Trump greets friends and family at Francis S. Gabreski Airport, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., August 17, 2018. Francis S. Gabreski Airport is the home of the New York Air National Guard's 106th Rescue Wing. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Senior Master Sgt. Cheran A. Cambridge)
